plan.summary: Deploy a lightweight, serverless webhook ingestion and asynchronous event router on Cloud Run with Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, and Firestore.
plan.architecture_overview: A single Cloud Run v2 service serves public webhook ingestion via POST /api/v1/events and internal async task execution via POST /api/v1/tasks/process. Ingested events are validated and published to Pub/Sub topic 'test-events-inbound'. A Pub/Sub push subscription delivers messages to the task processing endpoint, which archives raw event JSON to a regional GCS bucket with a 7-day lifecycle deletion rule and writes audit records to Firestore collection 'event_audit_records'. Scaling is configured for 0 to 3 instances for optimal cost-efficiency.

code_tasks.title: Implement Webhook Ingestion, Task Processing, and Health Endpoints
code_tasks.description: Build FastAPI service with GET /health returning status, service name, and engine. Implement POST /api/v1/events with Pydantic validation for event_type, source_system, payload, and timestamp, publishing to Pub/Sub. Implement POST /api/v1/tasks/process to decode Pub/Sub envelope, archive raw payload to GCS bucket at events/{year}/{month}/{event_id}.json, and write metadata to Firestore collection 'event_audit_records'.
acceptance_criteria: GET /health returns 200 with expected JSON payload
POST /api/v1/events validates payload and publishes to Pub/Sub returning 202
POST /api/v1/tasks/process writes to GCS and Firestore
Procfile configured for Google Cloud Native Buildpacks

code_tasks.description: Develop 100% test coverage suite using pytest and FastAPI TestClient with mocked Google Cloud Pub/Sub, Storage, and Firestore clients.
acceptance_criteria: Pytest suite passes with all routes covered and external GCP calls mocked
